capabilities: Toggle any open note into an editable radial mind map in the same tab
Edit nodes on the map (rename, add, delete, indent, reparent, check) with changes written back to the note
Render colon-prefixed lines as node annotations and show paragraphs, code blocks and tables as content cards
Export the map as Canvas, SVG, PNG or HTML
Configure layout, node source, branch colours, shortcuts and per-note fold state
extras: Not in the community plugin browser yet and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, so it must be installed manually.
intentEvidence: handles much like a desktop mind-mapping tool such as XMind or MindNode, except the data never stops being your markdown
problem: Obsidian has no way to view or edit a note's heading and bullet outline as a mind map without exporting it to a separate file.

relations.evidence: a desktop mind-mapping tool such as XMind or MindNode

summary: A view mode that turns any note into an editable radial mind map, writing every change straight back to the original markdown file.
